question: E1 validated F1_ARA (a close locked at the IDX upper auto-rejection limit) for detection and failed it for execution under the one plan the harness had: buy the next close, hold five sessions (-4.06% net per trade vs -0.53% for matched random entries, 2023). Is there a pre-specified execution plan under which the signals of the E1 family's ARA detectors, traded through the same harness, earn a positive average net return and beat matched random entries executed under the same plan?

builds_on.E1: research/E1/protocol.json (KOD-IDX-E1-v1): periods, event definition, matched controls, harness
builds_on.D1: MOONSHOT_E1_D1 v1.1 = F1_ARA; detection 9.3x matched random (p = 0.005); execution -4.06% vs -0.53% (results/runs/20261008T000401Z_MOONSHOT_E1_D1_v1.1)

data.tier: TIER_1 only (2021-01-22 .. 2025-02-21): exchange data, survivorship-complete; the panel is rebuilt from the pinned mirror commit bc0ac771, so its research-period rows are the rows E1 used
data.note: the manifest names are filled in when the rebuild finishes and before any E3 statistic is computed; the precondition below checks that the rebuilt data reproduces the recorded runs

precondition.rule: before any E3 statistic, the recorded E1 trading runs below are re-run on E3's panel and registry with their original configuration (idxsig e3-reproduce). REPRODUCED = identical signals, scored count, status counts, average net return and matched-random mean. If any deviates, discovery runs only with --accept-deviation, and both sides stay on record in research/E3/reproduce/result.json and discovery/summary.json

detectors.source: idxsig/rules/moonshot_e3.py: the three ARA members of the E1 family (F1, F7, F8), feature and flag code copied verbatim from idxsig/rules/moonshot_e1.py (a rule module imports nothing from the package; tests/test_e3.py checks the copy flags exactly as the original)
detectors.why_these: F1_ARA is D1. F7 and F8 are the E1 family's ARA rules with a volume and an earliness condition; E1 found D1's fills come when the continuation fails, so the family is searched for an earlier or stronger ARA signal as well as for a better plan. No rule outside the E1 family is admitted
detectors.harness_rule_ids: E3_CAND_<name> while SELECTED is None; MOONSHOT_E3_D1 after the freeze

definitions.fixed entry: buy at the close of session s+1 (the original model)
definitions.confirm: buy at the first close in s+1..s+3 that is above the signal close on the reference chain, traded and not locked at ARA (the move is holding and there are sellers); no such close = no trade (SKIP_NO_TRIGGER)
definitions.pullback: buy at the first close in s+1..s+3 that is below the signal close on the reference chain, traded and not locked at ARA (a dip after the signal); no such close = no trade
definitions.unlock: buy at the first traded close in s+1..s+3 that is not locked at ARA (wait for sellers); none = no trade
definitions.fixed exit: sell at the close of the holding_days-th session after entry (the original model)
definitions.stop_ref: sell at the first close in entry+1..entry+holding_days-1 at or below the signal session's reference price (IDX `previous`: the level before the signal day), else the fixed exit
definitions.first_down: sell at the first close in that range below its own reference price (a down day), else the fixed exit
definitions.all: a sale that lands on a session locked at ARB or untraded rolls to the next session where it is possible, as in the original model; levels are compared on the reference chain so a corporate-action reset is never read as a move; holding_days 1 is excluded because every exit rule then coincides with the fixed exit

plans.implementation: idxsig/execution.py ENTRY_RULES / EXIT_RULES, tests/test_plans.py; defaults reproduce every earlier run

harness.fill_model_note: FILL-C-v1 (research/IDX_CAUSAL_CAPACITY_v1): decision-time capacity from the 20 sessions up to the signal, in entry-session shares through registry-verified splits; an unverified reset in the window = SKIP_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN. Chosen over the original ex-post model A because the capacity is known when the decision is made
harness.lookahead: prefix-first (rules.causal_signals); the signal at d is what the detector returned from data through d only
harness.baselines: matched random (primary: same session, same v2 buckets, same plan) and same-session random, 200 draws each, exactly as the harness computes them for every run

periods.holdout_rule: sealed and not used by E3: the harness refuses any detector run whose window touches it (backtest.HOLDOUT) unless --holdout-final is given, which E3 never gives; trades whose window runs past a period's end are INCOMPLETE and not scored (the embargo)

selection.unit: one harness run per (detector, plan): 3 x 36 = 108 runs, every one reported in discovery/plans.csv so the size of the search is visible
admissible_if: average net return > 0 (after fees, in the harness's units)
average net return above the matched-random distribution with one-sided p < max_p_one_sided_vs_matched (200 draws: the floor is 0.005)
average net return > 0 in every discovery calendar year with at least min_scored_per_year scored trades (a plan that only worked in one year is not admitted)
selection.select: the admissible pair with the highest average net return; ties by more scored trades, then grid order; none admissible = no pair (SELECTED stays None, MOONSHOT_E3_D1 is never created, the paper policy keeps PASS)
selection.reference_note: D1's original plan under fill model C, reported beside the grid so the gain of any selected plan is measured against what E1 found
selection.freeze: the selected (detector, entry_rule, entry_window, exit_rule, holding_days) is written into idxsig/rules/moonshot_e3.SELECTED and committed before any validation statistic is computed; MOONSHOT_E3_D1 is the frozen pair and carries the plan (rules.Rule.plan), so its rule hash covers both

validation.on: validation only, one run, as a recorded harness run (results/runs/, RUNS.jsonl) of MOONSHOT_E3_D1
pass_if: average net return above the matched-random distribution with one-sided p < max_p_one_sided_vs_matched
reported_not_judged: 2023 is one year: no per-year check is possible
validation.consequence_if_passed: PAPER-POLICY-v4 may underwrite a paper BUY ON TRIGGER for MOONSHOT_E3_D1 candidates, with the plan's own entry trigger and exit; every such decision is scored prospectively by paper-score; real orders remain outside this lab
validation.consequence_if_failed: the paper policy keeps PASS; this plan family is exhausted for these detectors; a new family needs a new protocol and the holdout stays sealed

claims: Historical research. 108 plans were searched on discovery; validation is the one confirmatory test, and a pass there is one year of one market under assumed costs and daily-bar fills. Nothing here is prospective performance, nothing here grants entry permission, and the holdout remains reserved for one final test after prospective evidence exists.
